name: Buffet Fresh Cut Melon, Ripe Bananas & Mango vs. Bircher Muesli
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
whyItWorks: Fresh-cut cantaloupe, honeydew, seedless watermelon, and ripe bananas hydrate and supply potassium with almost zero insoluble roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Fill your fruit bowl with cantaloupe, honeydew, watermelon, and whole bananas. Strictly skip the grapefruit trays, orange segments, fibrous pineapple, and raw apple/nut Bircher muesli.
watchOuts: Grapefruit and orange trays next to the melon bar (strict avoid)
Raw grated apple skins and nuts in Bircher Muesli
